messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta@medisys.com>, Alex Novak <alex.novak@medisys.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Handoff: Medisys deployment — residency & SLO asks

Hi Grace / Karthik —

Quick handoff for a signed deal that needs CS + infra coordination. High-level: Medisys (Nat HLTH org) signed the MSA yesterday and returned the SOW. Key items to highlight for the implementation team:

- Contract & scope: 6-month pilot (internal-facing search + insights), then production ramp.
- Data residency: legal insisted on EU-only storage and processing (Austria region preferred).
- SLO/Support: Customer requested 99.9% monthly uptime and 4-hour P1 response during business hours (08:00–18:00 CET).
- Integrations: SFTP ingestion for batch imports + webhook for near-real-time deltas.
- Timeline: customer asked for technical kickoff week of Dec 8; executive kickoff Dec 10 if possible.
- Commercials: standard SOW except a one-time onboarding credit ($15k) we agreed to.

I've attached the signed MSA and SOW (filenames below). Please review items below before we lock kickoff:

- Confirm EU-dedicated environment availability and any uplift cost.
- Clarify who will own data residency proof points (audit logs, KMS config).
- Confirm whether we can meet 99.9% SLO for pilot (short sequence lengths, low concurrency) or need an SLO carve-out for pilot period.

Attachments: Medisys_SOW_v3.pdf, signed_MSA_Medisys.pdf

Next steps: Grace, can you take point on initial CS ownership? I will remain in loop for the first 30 days.

Thanks,
Ben

Ben — noted. Tessa, assigning CS ownership to the Implementation team; I will serve as the handoff PM and primary CS lead through the pilot. Proposed owner assignments below (please confirm):

- CS Lead (primary): Grace O'Connor (me) — overall owner for onboarding, success criteria, and program reporting.
- Implementation Eng Lead: Karthik Iyer — responsible for infra provisioning, ingestion connectors, and SFTP mapping.
- Project Manager (ops/coordination): Tessa Morgan — schedules meetings, tracks tasks, and runs the acceptance criteria checklist.

Open questions for Ben / Medisys before we schedule kickoff:
1) Can Medisys confirm the billing contact for order fulfillment and whether any PO number required for onboarding credit?
2) Are there any additional compliance artifacts beyond SOC 2 they need prior to kickoff (ISO, DPIA)?
3) For the EU residency ask: is Austria mandatory or "EU region" acceptable? If Austria is required we need to confirm capacity and provisioning lead time.

I will draft a kickoff agenda and propose slots for week of Dec 8. Ben, I'll loop you into the technical kickoff invite. Marta / Alex — appreciate a quick reply to the three questions above so we can lock dates.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 27 Nov 2025 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Medisys handoff — infra + resourcing quick note

Tessa / Karthik — internal note (not sent to customer):

Summary: Medisys requires EU-only processing and is asking for a 99.9% SLO. Pilot is low concurrency but must be demonstrably EU-resident. Karthik, please work with Infra Eng to confirm Austria region availability and estimated lead time for provisioning a dedicated tenant. If Austria is not available, get options for Germany (Frankfurt) or Netherlands and ETA.

Immediate asks:
- Karthik: confirm target instance type and whether we need a dedicated GPU pool or if multi-tenant with strict KMS separation suffices for legal.
- Tessa: block tentative kickoff times Dec 8–12 (two 60-min blocks: technical + exec) and prepare the acceptance checklist draft I can send to Medisys.
- Ops: escalate capacity questions to Platform team if lead time > 10 business days.

Related artifacts: HubSpot deal (link) and DocuSign envelope are in the thread. I'll prepare the kickoff agenda and a short runbook for EU-residency verification (keys, audit logs, certs) — will share by EOD tomorrow.

Grace

Hi Marta / Alex —

Thanks again for signing — excited to get started. Per Ben's note and our internal alignment, proposed next steps so we can lock dates and owners:

1) Technical kickoff (60 mins): propose Tue Dec 9 10:00 CET or Wed Dec 10 14:00 CET — please confirm one. Agenda: intro team, network/access requirements, SFTP mapping, sample data, basic acceptance criteria.
2) Executive kickoff (30 mins): Thu Dec 11 09:00 CET — optional for leadership.
3) Please confirm the following items before kickoff:
   - Billing contact and PO number (if required).
   - Any additional compliance artifacts required beyond SOC 2 (e.g., DPIA).
   - Data residency: is Austria mandatory or is EU-central acceptable?

We have attached a draft kickoff agenda and the signed SOW for your reference. If Austria residency is mandatory we will surface provisioning ETA (likely 7–12 business days depending on capacity) and any uplift cost. If EU-central is acceptable we'll provision in FRA/AMS and proceed faster.

Action items for Medisys: reply with preferred kickoff slot and answers to the three bullets above.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
